description: This source file defines a generic Factory interface for creating instances of type R possibly using an argument of type A. It serves as a base interface for factory patterns within the Apache OFBiz framework, providing a standard method signature for object instantiation.

classes.name: Factory
classes.description: A generic factory interface with a method to produce instances of type R, optionally using an object of type A.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns an instance of type R, possibly using an argument of type A to influence instantiation.
